meaning.situation_summary: The learner is at home and receives a photo of Sabrina drawing a flower in an art class.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Respond to Sabrina’s shared photo and request another photo.
meaning.coherence_explanation: The received photo supplies a natural reason for a short social reply. Giving an opinion and asking for another photo stay within the same exchange. No particular opinion or unseen relationship must be invented.
meaning.contrivance_check: Sabrina sends a photo from a drawing class while the learner is at home. Drawing a flower with a pencil is an ordinary class activity. Giving a photo opinion and asking for another photo form a plausible reply without an invented bowl costume or new event.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: The prompt explicitly separates the learner at home from Sabrina in her class. Messaging is the established medium for responding to the photo.
meaning.tone_reason: An adult drawing a flower in a class is an ordinary hobby scene.
meaning.final_source_recheck: Reread the complete final source-only packet after the title and image-brief repairs; both goals remain grounded in its stated prompt and picture facts.
